symptom: Browser registration requests targeted localhost port 8000, where the active Compose stack exposes no service.

root_cause.summary: The Axios fallback bypassed the existing same-origin frontend proxy and hardcoded an unrelated host port.

actions_attempted: Changed only the Axios default base URL to /api while preserving explicit VITE_API_BASE_URL overrides.
Rebuilt and restarted the current frontend image with Docker Compose.
Observed the frontend page and a sanitized invalid registration request through the Nginx proxy.
commands_rerun: docker compose --env-file finalsource/.env -f finalsource/compose.yaml up --build -d frontend
docker compose --env-file finalsource/.env -f finalsource/compose.yaml exec -T backend node -e <sanitized bounded proxy observation>
resolution: The browser client now uses same-origin /api; current frontend /register returned 200 and proxied registration reached the backend error envelope.
prevention: For the Docker runtime, use relative same-origin API paths when Nginx owns the browser-facing reverse proxy; avoid hardcoded host ports in client fallbacks.
